reason_summary: Prompt asked for a parallel policy-lifecycle rule-pack / dictionary and a policy-administration module. KYE already governs insurance authority via kye:rule-pack:insurance-underwriting-claims; a parallel lifecycle pack violates §0, re-mapping its frameworks violates §70, and a policy-admin system violates the honest scope (KYE governs whether the contract-changing act may proceed — it does not administer policies). Refusing all three.
remediation_hint: Build it as a Governed Agent PRODUCT that governs issuance, endorsement, renewal, cancellation / non-renewal (regulated-notice authority), lapse, and reinstatement against the EXISTING kye:rule-pack:insurance-underwriting-claims verdict. Add only agent-product artefacts (§52 binding, principal, refusal, product row, SKU, pricing, ™, gate) and BIND — never re-map — the existing insurance frameworks.
